Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?


Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Tech Lead - Data Engineering para se juntar ao nosso time em Data Plataform.


O que você vai fazer

Como Tech Lead de Data Engineering, você será a referência técnica em nossa infraestrutura de Data Platform, liderando iniciativas relacionadas à gestão de dados de interação com nossos clientes, incluindo a elaboração de demonstrativos de vendas e extratos. Terá papel fundamental na Transformação Tecnológica, apoiando a transição de sistemas legados (Oracle, PL SQL, OpenShift) para tecnologias modernas (Spark/Scala, SQL, Databricks, Atlas, Kubernetes), garantindo a continuidade dos negócios e a minimização de riscos.

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration
  • Solid understanding of CRM principles and Salesforce best practices
  • Experience in Sales Cloud and Salesforce Flow development, reporting, and dashboard creation
  • Experience with integration tools and third-party platforms
  • Ability to review, design, and test new features and customizations independently
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning as well as staying current with platform updates
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or a related field
  • Certification as a Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members on client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Senior Back-End Engineer
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Back-End Engineer with 5+ years of back-end software experience, including API and domain model design as well as JavaScript and Node.js development, to join our U.S. client's Platform Engineering team. The ideal candidate will design, build, and deliver high-quality, performant back-end services that power a world-class compliance and trust automation platform. The Platform Engineering team focuses on core components, such as authentication, RBAC, data architecture, and back-end infrastructure, ensuring reliability, performance, and scalability across the product suite.


Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our clients take the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy to a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their effectiveness against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Build services and APIs in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles and implement them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 5+ years of back-end software development experience designing APIs and domain models with knowledge of JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization protocols, such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with debugging and performance testing
  • A focus on delivering value and being action-oriented
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what your customers and team members need to be successful
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentlessness in pursuing goals and solving problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer science, engineering, or related field


Additional Information

  • Know that your ideas are heard and matter. Think big!
  • Own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart, creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them and be transparent!
  • Be recognized as an individual, no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.


Contract Type


Full-time

title: Senior UX/UI Designer (Client Web & Theme Systems)
description:
About Us

Olly Olly is a leader in digital marketing, specializing in local SEO and Google Business Profile (GBP) optimization. We empower small businesses, often in service-based and home service industries, to dominate their local markets. Alongside our bespoke marketing services, we offer a powerful SaaS platform that helps clients manage their social media, protect their online presence, and gain deep insights through reports and heatmaps.


We are a high-growth, high-volume company with an obsession for quality. Our internal teams are built for rapid, high-quality production, consistently launching new, fully-optimized client websites at a pace that sets us apart. We're hiring a top-tier designer to revolutionize the visual and functional foundation of this critical product.


A quick note: This role is not on our SaaS product team. This is a high-impact creative role focused on our client-facing web experiences and our main corporate brand.


The Mission

We’re not looking for just any designer. We’re looking for a UX/UI visionary to spearhead the design and define the standard of excellence for our client web division.


Your primary responsibility will be to design and conceptualize a new portfolio of "jaw-dropping," industry-leading web experiences. These designs will set the creative benchmark for all our client projects, ensuring they are not only visually stunning but are also powerful, high-converting tools.


You will be the lead architect of our client-facing web experience, directly influencing the conversion rates and brand perception of thousands of small businesses, as well as maintaining the polished look of our own corporate site.


Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Theme Architecture:  Spearhead the end-to-end design of a modular, scalable, and highly customizable website theme system (primarily for WordPress).
  • Visual Excellence & Conversion:  Create a portfolio of visually diverse, industry-leading themes that are modern, professional, and tailored to our clients' industries. Every design choice must be purposeful, driving visitors toward conversion.
  • SEO & Performance by Design:  Integrate SEO best practices, site speed principles, and accessibility (ADA) standards into the core of the theme system.
  • Production-First Thinking:  Design themes that are intuitive for our internal teams through a flexible and powerful system of modular blocks and layout options. Your system must make their processes seamless, efficient, and error-proof.
  • Company Website Ownership : Maintain and elevate our main corporate website. Design and implement new features, high-impact landing pages, and improvements that reinforce our position as an industry leader.
  • Iteration & Improvement:  Use data, competitor analysis, and design trends to continuously iterate and improve our themes' effectiveness, aesthetics, and usability.


What Makes You the Right Fit?

This is a senior role, and we have high expectations. The ideal candidate will live at the intersection of breathtaking visual design and rigorous systems-level thinking.


Must-Haves:

  • 7+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a heavy focus on web design (not just mobile/app design).
  • A world-class portfolio that must demonstrate:
  • Experience building scalable design systems (component libraries, style guides).
  • Evidence of multi-site, multi-brand, or theme-based web design.
  • A strong foundation in conversion-centered design (CRO) and data-driven decisions.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Figma,
  • Deep understanding of WordPress architecture, page builders (e.g., Gutenberg/Block Editor), and the technical constraints of a CMS.
  • Mastery of user-centered design (UCD), responsive design, typography, and color theory.
  • Pragmatic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS) and how they influence design. You don't need to be a developer, but you must know how to design for one.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can articulate and defend design decisions to leadership and provide crystal-clear documentation for production teams.
  • A pixel-perfect, meticulous attention to detail.
  • A foundational understanding of on-page SEO principles.


Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves):

  • Experience designing for small businesses or "blue-collar" service industries (plumbers, electricians, contractors, etc.).
  • Experience with heatmap and user session recording tools.


What You’ll Love About Working at Olly Olly

  • Competitive pay: A salary that truly reflects your expertise and experience.
  • 100% remote, work/life balance with a set, Monday-Friday 8 AM - 5 PM CST schedule
  • Work-life balance: Generous PTO, including 15 vacation days and U.S. holidays.
  • Growth-oriented culture: Join an inclusive, international, and innovative team where your contributions make a tangible difference.


Why Join Us? 

  • Massive Impact: Your work will have immediate and real-world impact, directly shaping the brand perception and bottom-line success of thousands of small businesses across the country.
  • A-Team Culture: We are a team of high-performers. You will be surrounded by (and challenged by) smart, driven colleagues who are passionate about quality.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: This is a key role. You will be given the trust and autonomy to architect your vision from the ground up.


How to Apply

If you are the systems-thinking design leader we're looking for, we want to see your work.


Portfolios submitted without clear examples of design systems or scalable web/theme projects will not be considered. In your application or cover letter, please briefly explain a project where you balanced visual uniqueness with systemic efficiency.


Diversity and Inclusion at Olly Olly

At Olly Olly, we celebrate differences in background, culture, abilities, and perspectives because diversity drives innovation and creativity. Your voice matters here, it really does! And your unique perspective will help us shape the future of small business growth.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

  • Remoto


Etapas do Processo Seletivo

✍Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Case/ Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.


Nossa Cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: Editor de vídeos curtos (shorts / Reels / TikTok)
description:
A MLPro está buscando um editor de vídeos freelancer para nos apoiar na criação de shorts para YouTube, Reels e TikTok , a partir de vídeos longos já gravados.


Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .

  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor Android PL
description:
Código da vaga: 56026


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Desenvolvedor android venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Experiência sólida com Kotlin e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento Android.

Conhecimento profundo em arquiteturas modernas e padrões de projeto.

Experiência com Compose , corrotinas e programação reativa.

Vivência com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação de testes.

Conhecimento em práticas de segurança e otimização de performance.

Experiência com Firebase e ferramentas de monitoramento.


Responsabilidades:

Dominar o ecossistema Android, acompanhando e aplicando as últimas atualizações do Google, incluindo novos SDKs, Jetpack e APIs.

Desenvolver aplicativos escaláveis e modulares utilizando Jetpack Compose , corrotinas , Flow e outras tecnologias modernas.

Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes unitários e de instrumentação , utilizando frameworks como JUnit , Espresso e MockK .

Implementar arquiteturas modernas como MVVM , MVI ou Clean Architecture .

Integrar e gerenciar dependências com Gradle , garantindo builds eficientes e bem estruturados.

Aplicar práticas avançadas de segurança no Android , incluindo encriptação, armazenamento seguro e proteção contra engenharia reversa.

Otimizar performance, gerenciando consumo de memória, renderização de UI e eficiência de bateria.

Trabalhar com DevOps para mobile , incluindo CI/CD , automação de testes e publicação na Google Play Store .

Atuar com observabilidade e analytics , utilizando serviços como Firebase .




Modelo - 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Fundada em 2014 pelo CEO Régis Oliveira, com mais de uma década de experiência, a ION desenvolve soluções digitais modernas com foco em cloud computing e mobile first, abrangendo dispositivos mobile (Android e iOS), sistemas web e serviços de integração.

Seu principal produto, o ION Vendas, é um aplicativo nativo e 100% em nuvem que revoluciona a automação comercial, oferecendo interação plena, atualizações em tempo real e acesso remoto. A empresa tem como missão transformar vidas por meio da tecnologia e inovação, investindo continuamente no que há de mais moderno para atender às necessidades do mercado, com expansão geográfica e foco em qualidade e atendimento humanizado.

Por que ser um Ionizador?

Na ION Sistemas, somos IONizados, parceiros em uma jornada de transformação digital e sucesso. Nosso compromisso vai além de oferecer soluções; buscamos impactar resultados e processos com inovação e eficiência.

Ser um IONizador é fazer parte de um time motivado, com autonomia para inovar e criar em um ambiente colaborativo e apaixonado pelo que faz. Movidos por entusiasmo e aprendizado contínuo, trabalhamos para oferecer o melhor atendimento e impulsionar empresas.

Junte-se a nós para construir o futuro com criatividade e impacto!



Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar, analisar e solucionar problemas em ambientes de cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud;
  • Administrar e manter serviços nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux, realizando configurações, atualizações e ajustes conforme necessário.
  • Automatizar processos e atividades de infraestrutura utilizando Python, Shell Scripting e Terraform.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas em infraestrutura e serviços.
  • Construção e Manutenção de Pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes conteinerizados com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Gerenciar ambientes para aplicações Java, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET Core e Node.js.

  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, QA e segurança para propor soluções escaláveis e seguras.
  • Traduzir demandas técnicas e de negócio em entregas efetivas.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência com múltiplas plataformas de nuvem: AWS, Google Cloud e Oracle Cloud.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).
  • Conhecimentos em containers e orquestradores (Docker e Kubernetes).
  • Certificação em ferramentas de monitoramento: Prometheus e Opensearch.
  • Vivência com pipelines de integração e entrega contínua.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de aplicações em Java, .NET e Node.js.

  • Diferenciais: Certificação em plataformas de nuvem: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer,Oracle Cloud Infrastructure DevOps Professional.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes em grande escala: Escalando clusters em ambientes complexos.
  • Conhecimento de SecOps: Integração de práticas de segurança em CI/CD.
  • Habilidade de atuar como ponte entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio.
  • Gestão de performance em tempo real: Ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana e Opensearch.


E o que nós oferecemos para que você faça bem o seu trabalho:

title: Solution Architect (Snowflake)
description:
Exadel is seeking a Solution Architect with Snowflake to work remote as an Independent contractor for a Global client (A U.S.-based education services provider). English is mandatory because this professional will have to report abroad. And design and architect end-to-end data solutions leveraging Snowflake as the primary cloud data platform.



Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain Medallion architecture in Snowflake, ensuring a robust dimensional data model for the gold layer.
  • Define and oversee data transformation processes using Coalesce.io, and manage data extraction and loading with Airbyte.
  • Integrate and modernize legacy data systems built on SQL Server/SSIS, with limited use of Azure Data Factory where required.
  • Design and optimize the BI semantic layer to enable self-service analytics in Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to translate business requirements into scalable data architecture solutions.
  • Establish best practices for data modeling, pipeline development, and version control using GitHub.
  • Track project progress and deliverables through Jira.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the Project team.



Qualifications


  • Proven experience as a Data Architect or Solution Architect with a strong background in cloud-based data platforms.



Required Skills


  • Hands-on expertise with Snowflake, Power BI, Coalesce.io, Airbyte, SQL Server/SSIS, and some exposure to Azure Data Factory.
  • Deep understanding of Medallion architecture and dimensional data modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of designing and maintaining BI semantic models for self-service analytics.
  • Experience establishing and enforcing data engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Familiarity with Jira for project management and GitHub for version control.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across both business and technical teams.
  • Minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern Time.



Preferred Skills


  • Exposure to Salesforce integration and data sources.
  • Experience in the higher education (higher ed) or ed-tech domain.

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Senior Software Developer - Java/Golang
description:
Java & Golang are MUST for this vacancy & should be reflected in your CV**


Project Description

Join a team building enterprise-scale headend applications for a leading video content provider. These backend cloud-based systems power critical media workflows and require high scalability, availability, and fault tolerance. You will design and implement microservices and AWS-based solutions within a Kubernetes environment.


Responsibilities

- Architect and develop backend microservices using Java and Golang.

- Design APIs and event-driven workflows for large-scale distributed systems.

- Ensure system reliability and performance through robust architecture and operational support.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile development cycles.

- Contribute to CI/CD pipeline optimization and automation.


Mandatory Skills Description

- Strong backend development experience in Java and Golang.

- Expertise in microservices, event-driven systems, and API design.

- Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases (key-value and document stores).

- Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, MSK, CDK).

- Kubernetes deployment and orchestration expertise.

- Skilled in software/system design for scalability and fault tolerance.

- Experience with CI/CD environments and tools.

- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Python scripting for automation.

- Knowledge of Spring Framework.

- Familiarity with network protocols (HTTP, REST, TCP/IP).


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Engenheiro DevOps Pleno/Sênior
description:
ION SISTEMAS Somos especialista no desenvolvimento de softwares de automação de vendas para atacadistas e distribuidores!


A ION Sistemas é uma empresa jovem, dinâmica e inovadora, com um ambiente de trabalho leve e colaborativo, ideal para talentos que desejam crescer e contribuir em projetos de impacto. Fundada em 2014 pelo CEO Régis Oliveira, com mais de uma década de experiência, a ION desenvolve soluções digitais modernas com foco em cloud computing e mobile first, abrangendo dispositivos mobile (Android e iOS), sistemas web e serviços de integração.

Seu principal produto, o ION Vendas, é um aplicativo nativo e 100% em nuvem que revoluciona a automação comercial, oferecendo interação plena, atualizações em tempo real e acesso remoto. A empresa tem como missão transformar vidas por meio da tecnologia e inovação, investindo continuamente no que há de mais moderno para atender às necessidades do mercado, com expansão geográfica e foco em qualidade e atendimento humanizado.

Por que ser um Ionizador?

Na ION Sistemas, somos IONizados, parceiros em uma jornada de transformação digital e sucesso. Nosso compromisso vai além de oferecer soluções; buscamos impactar resultados e processos com inovação e eficiência.

Ser um IONizador é fazer parte de um time motivado, com autonomia para inovar e criar em um ambiente colaborativo e apaixonado pelo que faz. Movidos por entusiasmo e aprendizado contínuo, trabalhamos para oferecer o melhor atendimento e impulsionar empresas.

Junte-se a nós para construir o futuro com criatividade e impacto!



Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Monitorar, analisar e solucionar problemas em ambientes de cloud (AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud;
  • Administrar e manter serviços nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux, realizando configurações, atualizações e ajustes conforme necessário.

  • Identificar e resolver problemas em infraestrutura e serviços.

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes conteinerizados com Docker e Kubernetes
  • Gerenciar ambientes para aplicações Java, ASP.NET, .NET Framework, .NET Core e Node.js.

  • Traduzir demandas técnicas e de negócio em entregas efetivas.



Requisitos:

  • Experiência com múltiplas plataformas de nuvem: AWS, Google Cloud e Oracle Cloud.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Terraform, Ansible, etc.).

  • Certificação em ferramentas de monitoramento: Prometheus e Opensearch.
  • Vivência com pipelines de integração e entrega contínua.

  • Experiência com microsserviços: Implementação e manutenção de soluções escaláveis.

  • Experiência com Kubernetes em grande escala: Escalando clusters em ambientes complexos.
  • Conhecimento de SecOps: Integração de práticas de segurança em CI/CD.
  • Habilidade de atuar como ponte entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio.
  • Gestão de performance em tempo real: Ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana e Opensearch.

title: Editor de vídeos curtos (shorts / Reels / TikTok)
description:
A MLPro está buscando um editor de vídeos freelancer para nos apoiar na criação de shorts para YouTube, Reels e TikTok , a partir de vídeos longos já gravados.


Nosso conteúdo é técnico/educacional , focado em Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, PMO e gestão de projetos, para serem publicados nas nossas redes sociais e Youtube (@MLProPPM).


Responsabilidades:

  • Cortar trechos de vídeos longos para criar shorts de até 40–60 segundos .
  • Adaptar do formato horizontal para vertical (9:16), mantendo bom enquadramento.
  • Inserir legendas dinâmicas , com destaque em palavras-chave, sem erros de português.
  • Seguir a identidade visual da MLPro  (cores, logo e estilo mais sóbrio, não infantil).
  • Entregar arquivos em alta qualidade, prontos para publicação nas redes.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos para redes sociais (shorts, Reels, TikTok).
  • Portfólio específico de shorts/ vídeos curtos  já publicados.
  • Atenção a detalhes de áudio, texto e ritmo de edição.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com conteúdo técnico/educacional.

Modelo de trabalho:

  • Vaga 100% remota, formato freelancer.
  • Pacote inicial mensal de vídeos curtos, com possibilidade de expansão conforme resultados.


Na candidatura pelo LinkedIn, anexe seu portfólio de vídeos curtos  (documento com links dos vídeos) no campo de currículo (CV) . Candidaturas sem portfólio de vídeos curtos  não serão consideradas.

title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote – UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.


UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.


This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: Accounting & Administrative Coordinator
description:
We are looking for a highly capable Accountant to support the financial operations of MoveUp across multiple entities.


In this role, you will ensure the smooth running of daily accounting activities, reinforce financial controls, and provide essential backup across all key operational processes.


This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys solving complex operational challenges, and is committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and reliability in our financial workflows.


Specifically, your role will involve:


Customer Billing & Receivables


  • Create, validate, and issue customer invoices
  • Manage invoicing workflows
  • Monitor incoming payments and perform payment matching
  • Execute customer reminders and maintain updated follow-up tracking
  • Maintain customer reporting and ensure accuracy of receivables data


Supplier Accounting & Payables


  • Verify and validate supplier invoices
  • Ensure correct accounting allocation of supplier expenses
  • Support the monthly payables closing process


Bank Reconciliation & Treasury Support


  • Perform reconciliations for multi-currency accounts
  • Assist with treasury tracking and cash flow updates


General Accounting & Reporting


  • Support the bookkeeping
  • Maintain and control analytical entries
  • Participate in quarterly closings
  • Ensure compliance with internal financial processes


Cross-Entity Support & Process Improvements


  • Contribute to standardizing accounting processes across the group
  • Participate in internal projects workflow optimization, workflow automation, reporting enhancement
  • Improve documentation and build a finance operational manual


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Minimum 3 years of experience in accounting
  • Strong understanding of bookkeeping, reconciliations, and financial workflows
  • Experience with Odoo is a plus
  • Solid Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Ability to work across multiple entities and currencies
  • Strong attention to detail, reliability, and autonomy
  • English required; Portuguese or French is a plus
  • Experience with international accounting environments is appreciated


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next Steps in the Process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for You


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.


Ideal Background

  • 8–12 years of experience designing or implementing large-scale distributed data platforms in regulated industries.
  • Proven track record as a technical architect or lead engineer at Cloudera, Databricks, AWS EMR, or similar open-source platform providers.
  • Hands-on experience integrating and operating open-source data tools across hybrid-cloud and containerized environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise governance and security frameworks (SOX, FFIEC, GDPR).
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to influence architecture decisions across engineering and client teams.


Success Criteria

  • Delivery of a validated, production-ready platform architecture that meets client requirements.
  • Positive approval outcomes from Architecture Review Boards and internal security/governance reviews.
  • Defined and documented integration standards adopted by all implementation teams.
  • Successful enablement of platform engineers and developers through patterns, templates, and technical guidance.
  • Measurable reduction in deployment friction, downtime, or rework during environment rollouts.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Desenvolvedor Sharepoint/Power Platform
description:

  • Otimizar a busca do SharePoint: refinadores, Managed Properties, Search Schema e consultas KQL.
  • Desenvolver páginas modernas e web parts customizadas (SPFx / PnP) para portais de GED.


Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida em SharePoint Online e arquitetura de informação (taxonomia, Content Types, Term Store).
  • Domínio de Power Automate para fluxos avançados de aprovação.
  • Experiência prática com Schema de Busca (Crawled/Managed Properties e KQL).
  • Forte conhecimento em segurança do SharePoint: permissões, grupos, herança.
  • Experiência com SPFx e bibliotecas PnP para customizações modernas.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Microsoft Purview (retenção, labels, DLP).

  • Power Apps (Canvas Apps, formulários customizados).

title: Desenvolvedor Sharepoint/Power Platform
description:
Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Sharepoint/Power Platform com forte domínio na estruturação de ambientes corporativos de GED, organização de taxonomia e Content Types, implementação de governança e segurança, além de otimização avançada de busca. É essencial ter sólida experiência com Power Automate para criar fluxos complexos, além de capacidade de customização utilizando SPFx e PnP. O(a) profissional ideal combina visão arquitetural, conhecimento profundo do ecossistema M365 e habilidade para entregar soluções modernas, escaláveis e padronizadas para gestão de documentos.


Responsabilidades

  • Estruturar e configurar ambientes SharePoint Online (Hub Sites, sites de Comunicação e Equipe) garantindo navegação escalável e organizada.
  • Traduzir a hierarquia de documentos (Política, Norma, Manual etc.) em Content Types , Metadados Gerenciados e taxonomia no Term Store .
  • Criar bibliotecas otimizadas, priorizando metadados, versionamento, governança e boas práticas de performance.
  • Implementar governança: versionamento Major/Minor, check-in/check-out, aprovação de conteúdo e modelo seguro de permissões com grupos e quebra de herança controlada.
  • Configurar políticas de retenção e rotulagem de confidencialidade (Purview).
  • Automatizar processos com Power Automate (fluxos complexos, condicionais, múltiplas etapas) e criar formulários estruturados em Power Apps.
  • Otimizar a busca do SharePoint: refinadores, Managed Properties, Search Schema e consultas KQL.
  • Desenvolver páginas modernas e web parts customizadas (SPFx / PnP) para portais de GED.


Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência sólida em SharePoint Online e arquitetura de informação (taxonomia, Content Types, Term Store).
  • Domínio de Power Automate para fluxos avançados de aprovação.
  • Experiência prática com Schema de Busca (Crawled/Managed Properties e KQL).
  • Forte conhecimento em segurança do SharePoint: permissões, grupos, herança.
  • Experiência com SPFx e bibliotecas PnP para customizações modernas.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência com Microsoft Purview (retenção, labels, DLP).
  • Experiência em migração para SharePoint Online (ShareGate, Migration Manager).
  • Power Apps (Canvas Apps, formulários customizados).
  • Automação com PowerShell (PnP.PowerShell).

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote


************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************


Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.


This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It’s a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.


  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.


  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.


  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.


  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).


  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.


  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.



Skills & Qualifications :


  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.


  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.


  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.


  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.


  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.


  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.


  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.


This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.
